div.div:
LLM provider chain (every worker: LLM-first → deterministic fallback): OpenAI API → deterministic rules
every system prompt carries the shared embedded-instruction guard (LLM01) · per-provider circuit breaker (ASI08) · kill switch forces deterministic-only (ASI10)

div.div: Concurrency & transport — workers keep per-case state, so every request gets its own worker set (new_session); shared across requests only: clinic dataset, hours snapshot, OneMap client + token, route cache, ML model. The stream emits a keepalive comment every 10 s because the Next /api proxy aborts an upstream that is silent for 30 s. Tool use is allow-listed and enforced at every call site (ml.predict, llm.complete, rag.retrieve, safety_nlp.classify, clinic.lookup, facility.hours.lookup, travel.estimate, escalation.create, critique); Care-Routing is the one worker whose model CHOOSES among its tools, inside a bounded ReAct loop.
